title: Are We Experiencing The Mall World in Pieces?

classification.theory_summary: Proposes Mall World as a collective/shared experience akin to déjà vu, with dreamlike locations (airport/daycare/shopping center) appearing in real life as if sections are revealing themselves.

meta.author_theory: Mall World may be a collective/shared experience similar to déjà vu; the author feels they are seeing pieces of it appear in real life, like sections revealing themselves, which feels significant.
